protocol.prediction_time: scheduled start − 30 min; inputs: games on earlier dates only

baselines.elo: FiveThirtyEight NHL Elo form (MOV multiplier 0.6686·ln(MOV)+0.8048), K/HFA/reversion tuned on the selection window
baselines.goals_only: the same GLM on goals ratings and rest only

data.source: hockey/data/team_games (sportsdataverse fastRhockey, from the NHL public game feeds)
data.license: sportsdataverse/fastRhockey-nhl-data and -raw are MIT-licensed repositories; the game data inside them is compiled from the NHL's public game feeds and remains the NHL's. NHL.com terms restrict commercial use of its content: the owner must review this before NHL output is sold in a paid tier. Attribution is printed on every NHL artifact.

selection.rule: lowest selection-window moneyline log loss; a challenger must beat the incumbent by >= 0.001

moneyline.market_reason: no licensed archive of timestamped NHL closing prices is on file (hockey/market/closing/); until one is, no NHL price is called an edge

caveats: Outcome validation only: no licensed archive of NHL closing prices is available to this build, so the model has NOT been compared with the market. Beating Elo is not beating a sportsbook.

The xG model is fitted walk-forward on seasons before each season it scores; from 2022-23 the source changed how it records shot locations and the xG model is less well calibrated on those seasons (hockey/xg/report.json).
Confirmed-goalie results assume the starter is known 30 minutes before puck drop; prices posted earlier use the projected starter.
Playoff games are included and use sudden-death overtime; they are a small share of every window.
